mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, we have overcast skies and a temperature of 64 degrees at Badger Ridge Middle School, which feels like 61 degrees.
The city is highlighting new requirements for erosion and stormwater management permits, while paving work is scheduled for November 9 and 10 on North Nine Mound Road and several other local streets.
There is plenty to do with trivia night happening today at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, followed by live music and yoga sessions throughout the rest of the week.
Regarding local activity, on October 19, a 49-year-old Verona man was stopped for driving with a suspended license and was subsequently taken into custody for an active arrest warrant.
You can enjoy today's flavor of the day, which is Turtle Cheesecake, as the local Culver's is currently open and will remain so until 10 PM this evening.
